verdict.rationale: GitHub evidence shows Gemini CLI can automate operational tasks, run non-interactively via GitHub Actions, and even do PR reviews/issue triage (gh-4,6,10,11,12), suggesting some capacity for autonomous end-to-end work, but this is closer to a CI/scripting integration than a full cloud agent that builds, tests, and demos a feature. Community reports directly contradict reliable end-to-end agentic execution, citing loops, botched file operations, poor codebase navigation, and lack of a plan mode (comm-10, comm-11, comm-14, comm-15, comm-16).
